## At work {.no-anchor}

At Analog Devices I develop demand forecasting methods for the semiconductor supply chain and the machine learning systems that run them in production.

[Analog Devices <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>](https://www.analog.com){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

## Research {.no-anchor}

I presented my PhD defence at Instituto Superior Técnico in November 2026, on efficient and robust machine learning for net-load forecasting in low-voltage distribution systems.

[Slides <i class="bi bi-easel" aria-hidden="true"></i>](../talks/phd-defence-2026/index.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

## Software {.no-anchor}

I maintain Twiga, Milia, Popo, Kinyonga and Kobe, open-source tools for forecasting, load profiles, network simulation and project setup.
